sections.content:
When a sentence contains both an indirect and a direct object pronoun, they always appear together in a strict sequence:

[ INDIRECT ] + [ DIRECT ] + [ VERB ]
(To whom) + (What) + (Action)

sections.title: Double Pronoun Combinations
rows: Sí, te lo presto. (Yes, I lend it to you.)
Sí, me la dio. (Yes, he gave it to me.)
Sí, nos las mandaron. (Yes, they sent them to us.)
Mi tío me lo regaló. (My uncle gave it to me.)

items.spanish: ¿Tienes el dinero? —Sí, mi hermano me lo dio.
items.english: Do you have the money? —Yes, my brother gave it to me.

items.spanish: Te prometo que mañana te lo explico.
items.english: I promise you that tomorrow I'll explain it to you.

sections.content: Remember: 'People before things' (indirect person first, direct thing second).
